in_sanskrit.name: मध्विका
in_sanskrit.meaning: She who is dear to Lord Madhvacharya
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is fondly loved by Lord Madhvacharya, a revered philosopher and the founder of the Dvaita School of Hinduism.

in_hindi.name: मध्विका
in_hindi.long_meaning: वैश्नव धर्म के द्वैत विहार स्कूल के प्रथम पंदित और धर्म के विरूद्ध विशेषज्ञ मध्वाचार्य के लिए प्रेमी हूँ।

in_marathi.name: Madhvika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of beauty and sweetness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Madhvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Madhvika is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘madhvi’ meaning honey, and ‘ka’ meaning face. The name Madhvika represents the goddess of beauty and sweetness. It is a beautiful name for a baby girl.
